story.title: How I Feel
paragraphs_en: ​Sometimes my heart beats fast. Sometimes I scream and shout. Some things make me giggle. Other things make me pout.
​Can you tell me how I feel? And can you tell me why? Can you tell me why I smile? What makes me want to cry?
​Sssss! Do you hear that? What is that hissing sound? I freeze, I gasp, I tremble. My eyes grow big and round. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Wheeeee! Today is special. Nani is coming to stay! My face glows, my eyes shine. I jump and shout, “Hurray!” Can you tell me how I feel?
​Ewwwww! My shoes are stinky. I think I stepped in poop. I clench my fists. I wrinkle my nose. Yuck! Yucky doo! Can you tell me how I feel?
​​​I have to return this library book, but I tore it by mistake. I chew my nails. I sweat a bit. My knees begin to shake. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Is that enormous package really a gift—for me? My mouth falls open. My eyebrows fly up. I wonder what it could be. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Iiish! I squirm and shuffle my feet. I told a lie today. I hang my head. My face is red. I don’t know what to say. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Sniff! Nani is leaving. I stand and wave goodbye. My mouth curves down, my eyes are red, and I begin to cry. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Grrrr! I’m not sleepy! I don’t want to go to bed! I gnash my teeth. I stomp my feet. My face is fiery red. Can you tell me how I feel?
​Mamma’s hugs are lovely. Cuddly, warm and tight. I sigh and smile and kiss her cheek. My eyes are big and bright. Can you tell me how I feel?
